output.brief: The crash gap is driven by build 7.4.0, not by the Tiled Canvas flag. Flagged users are on 7.4.0 only because the flag requires a capability that first ships in 7.4.0. Within 7.4.0, flag-on and holdout users crash at nearly the same rate (2.10% vs 1.98%; the interval includes zero). The gap was already present on 2–3 Sep, before the ramp. Device memory mix and usage are the same across groups. The top crash is a native SIGSEGV in the Pixelda 3.1 image library, which 7.3.2 does not ship, and the app-store console independently shows the same gap. Turning the flag off will not fix it, and rolling 7.4.0 to 100% on 18 Sep would spread it. Next: hold the 7.4.0 rollout at 25%, prioritise a Pixelda fix build, and keep the flag and crash reporting as they are. Confidence is moderate: the flag's effect is not fully ruled out (a few tenths of a point), and I did not check the sync-service or device-level detail beyond what was provided.
